title: Pure Clear World
summary: Nightshroud's Attributeless Clear World control build, paired with Field Spell searchers, Kaijus, and generic staples. While face-up on the field, every Clear monster is treated as having no Attribute, so your board ignores Clear World's Attribute penalties while the opponent takes the full lockdown.

summary.title: Starters
points: Planet Pathfinder Tributes itself to add Clear World from the Deck, clearing its own EARTH body off the field so you never suffer Clear World's EARTH penalty.
Terraforming searches Clear World directly, while Clear Wall searches any monster that mentions Clear World: Clear Vicious Knight, Clear Vice Dragon, Clear Phantom, Clear Rage Golem, or Clear Cube.
Clear Cube can be Normal Summoned or Set without Tributes and floats into another Clear Cube from the Deck whenever it leaves the field face-up, supplying steady Tribute fodder.

summary.title: Opening: Clear Wall + Clear World
steps: Activate Clear World (directly or via Planet Pathfinder or Terraforming) and activate Clear Wall.
Use Clear Wall to search Clear Cube or Clear Vicious Knight from the Deck.
Normal Summon Clear Cube; on the next turn or with an existing body, Tribute Summon Clear Vicious Knight with 1 Tribute while Clear Cube floats into a fresh copy from the Deck.

summary.title: Attribute Penalties & Kaijus
points: Clear World punishes players during each turn and End Phase based on the Attributes they control: LIGHT reveals the hand, DARK locks out attacking when controlling 2 or more monsters, EARTH destroys a monster, WATER forces a discard, FIRE burns for 1000 LP, and WIND blocks Spell activations.
Radian, the Multidimensional Kaiju Tributes an opposing boss and plants a DARK monster on their board to enforce Clear World's DARK attack lock.
Dogoran, the Mad Flame Kaiju removes a problem threat and gives the opponent a FIRE monster so Clear World burns them for 1000 damage during their End Phase.

summary.title: Bosses & Payoff
points: Clear Vicious Knight Tribute Summons with 1 monster, gains the highest original ATK on the opponent's field while you control no other cards, and ignores Clear World.
Clear Vice Dragon gains double the ATK of any monster it attacks and discards a card from the hand to survive destruction at the end of the Damage Step.

Clear Phantom discards itself and another Clear card when destroyed by battle to destroy a monster on the field and mill 3 cards from the opponent's Deck, while Clear Rage Golem burns for 300 damage per card in the opponent's hand when it deals battle damage.

summary.title: Spells
points: Clear Wall searches a Clear monster every turn, protects face-up Attack Position Clear monsters from battle destruction, and reduces any battle damage over 1000 you would take from a Clear monster's battle to 0 (or destroys itself to negate lethal damage).
